The '''Poison Pit''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located in the city of [[Jiguuna]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR" /> [[Ula Vii]] met [[Jet Nebula]] there in [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="FA">''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]''</ref> [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunters]] [[Braden]] and [[Jory]] were killed in the cantina by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] bounty hunter [[Tarro Blood]] at the beginning of the [[Great Hunt (c. 3643 BBY)|Great Hunt of 3643 BBY]]. The cantina was marked by a recognizable [[holosign]] depicting a [[chemilizard]].<ref name="TOR" />
